title: ＜政治部取材メモ＞「やり方が活動家」　立民合流反対派に苛立つ中道　辺野古で対立激化か
extracted_text: 参院で存続している立憲民主党の中で、衆院で立民と公明党が立ち上げた中道改革連合への合流をめぐる対立が先鋭化しつつある。立民執行部が合流の可否について曖昧な態度を取り続ける一方、反対派からは米軍普天間飛行場（沖縄県宜野湾市）の名護市辺野古移設問題などを理由に決裂を促すような動きがある。中道結成から3カ月がたったが、収束に至る気配はない。 「重要政策で違いが明らかな部分がある。不安、疑念が出ているとすれば受け止めなければいけないが、この先は（3党で）協議していくことに他ならない」　立民の水岡俊一代表は4月27日の定例記者会見で、政策で隔たりがある中道、公明との3党連携の「行きつく先」について問われたが、回答を濁した。　「その先に何があるのかといわれて、『これがあります』と答えられたら一番いいのだけれど…」とも語った水岡氏。その言葉の端々から、合流を悲観するニュアンスを感じたのは筆者だけではあるまい。
translated_text: Among the Constitutional Democratic Party of Japan (CDP), which continues in the House of Councillors, conflict over the merger with the Centrist Reform Alliance launched by CDP and Komeito in the House of Representatives is becoming increasingly acute. While the CDP leadership continues to take an ambiguous stance on whether to proceed with the merger, opposition factions are pushing for a break, citing issues such as the relocation of the U.S. Marine Corps Air Station Futenma to Henoko in Nago City, Okinawa Prefecture. Three months have passed since the formation of the centrist alliance, but there is no sign of resolution. 'There are clear differences on important policies. If there are concerns and doubts, we must address them, but moving forward, there is no other choice but to continue negotiations among the three parties.' CDP representative Shunichi Mizukawa gave a vague answer when asked at his regular press conference on April 27 about the 'outcome' of the three-party alliance with the centrist Komeito, which has policy gaps. 'If asked what lies ahead, it would be best if I could say, 'here it is,' but...' Mizukawa also said. From his words, the author senses a pessimistic tone about the merger - likely not the only one.
title_en: <Political Desk Coverage Memo> 'Methodology of Activists' - Frustrated Centrists with CDP Merger Opponents; Conflict May Intensify over Henoko
